evidence: Receiving DO2 10.84 mg/L at 52 h vs sources 10.81-11.47 mg/L; floor 2.0 mg/L never approached
Receiving P assay: 1.09 g/L @36 h, 3.10 g/L @48 h, matching source batches (1.02-1.12 and 2.98-3.06 g/L)
24 h DO2 dip and 28 h recovery pattern identical across source-1/2/3 and receiving
Source histories show peak P near 72 h under KEEP, then natural decline; intervention at 52 h would only perturb
submission.rationale: Receiving fermentation matches healthy source-batch trajectories in both DO2 and delayed product assays. DO2 is ~10.8 mg/L at the 52 h decision point, more than five times the 2.0 mg/L oxygen minimum, with the 24-28 h dip/recovery matching source behavior. Product is accumulating on schedule (3.10 g/L at 48 h vs 2.98-3.06 in sources). Bounded interventions (reduce_feed 0.8x, increase_air 1.15x, combined) would perturb a normal run with no evidence of oxygen stress or overfeeding; stop would forfeit production. KEEP is the appropriate recommendation.
submission.uncertainty: Assays are delayed (4 h availability clock); current true P could differ modestly from the 48 h value. Receiving process parameters are stated to differ from source, so future divergence from source trajectories (e.g., a hidden oxygen-demand event) cannot be excluded; however, no anomaly indicator is present and the margin above the DO2 floor is large.
